title: Wheel-controlled microphone mute
summary: This release adds native Windows microphone actions to Pivot's existing wheel and controller mappings.
highlights: Bind a wheel, controller, or button-box control to toggle, mute, or unmute a microphone without keyboard shortcuts.
Target the current default microphone, communications microphone, or a specific Windows capture device.
Use profile-specific or global microphone bindings with existing modifier support and press-edge handling.
Optional Pivot-owned ascending and descending chimes confirm the verified microphone state.
The profile mapping editor now has clearer confirmations, correctly styled controls, and a taller bindings list.
